# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 07 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale Market

- **HDB resale volumes hit 2026 high in July, but prices soften** - July recorded 2,660 HDB resale transactions, the highest monthly volume so far in 2026, while the resale price index continued to ease, sitting 0.7% below its level a year ago. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-transactions-hit-2026-high-in-july-as-prices-continue-to-fall/)

- **Bishan executive maisonette sets new national record at S$1.65 million** - A high-floor executive maisonette in Bishan changed hands on 4 August 2026 for S$1.65 million, making it both the priciest HDB resale flat in Bishan and the most expensive executive flat ever sold in Singapore. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/s1-65m-bishan-maisonette-becomes-singapores-priciest-executive-flat-to-date/)

## En Bloc Developments

- **Parliament introduces bill to lower en bloc consent thresholds for older developments** - The Land Titles (Strata) (Amendment) Bill 2026, introduced on 4 August, proposes reducing the owner-consent requirement for collective sales to 70% for developments aged 40–59 years, down from the current 80%. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/proposed-en-bloc-consent-thresholds/)

- **Proposed reforms would cut thresholds further for condos aged 60 and above** - Under the same proposed legislation, developments 60 years or older would require only 65% owner consent for a collective sale, compared with the current 80% threshold. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/new-proposal-revive-en-bloc-hopes-for-older-condos/)

- **Lakeside Towers launches third en bloc attempt at unchanged $350 million reserve price** - The 45-year-old development has relaunched its collective sale tender for the third time at the same $350 million reserve price, having not found a buyer in its 2018, 2022 or 2023 attempts. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/this-45-year-old-condo-making-third-en-bloc-attempt-350-million-price-tag/)

## Infrastructure & New Launches

- **Cross Island Line Phase 3 to add four stations extending west to Gul Circle** - Announced on 31 July 2026, CRL Phase 3 will extend the line approximately 10 km from the future Jurong Lake District station to Gul Circle via four new stations in Singapore's western corridor. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/cross-island-line-phase-3/)
